a3a64199-919d-4ef2-8fcb-37e2efd0c2b7@nin.know: "Division" refers to the four-team group (49ers, Seahawks, Rams, Cardinals) they compete with for a guaranteed playoff spot. 47814a54-1ab1-4c59-87a4-3b6d2a74a937@ufc.know: A title fight means a championship belt changes hands only here, not in regular bouts. A decision means judges scored every round because no knockout or submission ended the fight. Yan is only the third fighter to win the UFC bantamweight title twice, after Dominick Cruz and TJ Dillashaw, showing how rare repeat title reigns are.
